critical_code_review_comments: BillingSelfService.jsx line 154: 'preview.net_due > 0' uses toLocaleString() without currency formatting consistency (shows raw '271.63' before CAD). Minor — works.

AdminAudit.jsx: audit-action dropdown is populated by data?.actions from the server; if server returns empty list, user only sees 'All actions'. During test the dropdown only had 'All actions' until a filter query loaded options — consider pre-seeding or always returning the full LABEL keys for discoverability.
AdminAudit export relies on blob download + <a>.click() with no user-visible success feedback; a toast on success would improve UX.
